issues.claim: NJ Leaf - North Brunswick, website https://www.gsb-nj.com/
issues.problem: Wrong website. The North Brunswick dispensary at 1345 US-1 is NJ Leaf, whose own site is njleaf.com; gsb-nj.com is the domain/email of Garden State Botanicals, an earlier cannabis business name (same street address). The entry also relies on an Overpass API URL as its only evidence, which is not a stable citation.
issues.fix: Replace the website with https://njleaf.com/location/north-brunswick-township-nj/ and cite that page (it states North Brunswick Township, locally owned).

issues.claim: Circle Motel, North Brunswick, address Unknown, phone Unknown
issues.problem: Could not confirm this business exists in North Brunswick. The cited Yellow Pages category URL does not surface a North Brunswick Circle Motel; motel listings for the town show only Farrington Inn. No address, phone or independent page found.
issues.fix: Drop the entry unless a North Brunswick address is found; do not spend triage time on it.

issues.claim: Adorable Doos, 2 Quarry Ln, North Brunswick
issues.problem: Wrong town. The business's own website states the grooming salon is at 332 Ridge Rd, Dayton, NJ 08810 (off Route 130), not North Brunswick. The North Brunswick address appears only in older directories.
issues.fix: Remove from the North Brunswick zone, or move to the Dayton/South Brunswick zone after confirming it still operates at the Dayton address.

issues.claim: Minuteman Press North Brunswick included as a locally operated print shop
issues.problem: Excluded type: it is a franchise of the Minuteman Press franchise system (the shop opened in 2021 under named franchisees), and the entry itself notes the brand-franchise flag.

issues.claim: The Ashi (Emporio by Ashi Boutique Hotel & Banquet), 999 US-1, described as an independent banquet/boutique-hotel operation
issues.problem: It now trades as 'The Ashi, an Ascend Collection Hotel' - Ascend Collection is a Choice Hotels brand, i.e. a chain-flagged property, which the mapper's own caveats said were excluded. Description is also out of date.
issues.fix: Remove the hotel; if the separately operated banquet business is the target, confirm an independently owned operator and cite its own page.

issues.claim: All American Pet Resorts North Brunswick, described as 'appears locally operated at this single site'
issues.problem: The company's own site hosts franchise-development documents and an available-territories page, so it is a franchised brand, not an independent single-site business. Ownership at 330 Thalia St is unverified.
issues.fix: Confirm the local owner/operator in writing, otherwise exclude as a franchise.

issues.claim: Prince Brothers Custom Tailoring, source_urls include https://ginos-custom-tailoring.hub.biz/
issues.problem: Citation mismatch: that URL is a hub.biz page for 'Gino's Custom Tailoring', a different business name, and it returns HTTP 403. The entry's facts (780 Livingston Ave, 732-846-4327) are supported by the Yellow Pages profile instead.
issues.fix: Replace with https://www.yellowpages.com/north-brunswick-nj/mip/prince-brothers-custom-tailoring-4128087 and drop the Gino's URL.

issues.claim: Costello's Ace Hardware included as a locally owned dealer, not a chain store
issues.problem: Borderline exclusion. Ace is a retailer-owned co-op and this dealer operates several New Jersey stores under the Costello's Ace name, so 'independent local business' is a judgment call rather than a fact.
issues.fix: Keep only with an explicit note that it is a multi-store Ace dealer, or exclude it if the brief's chain test is strict.

issues.claim: Coverage of instruction/education businesses (dance, music, driving, tutoring schools already listed)
issues.problem: Four martial arts schools in town are missing although the same category type is listed: Brunswick's Martial Arts Academy (2232 Route 130), MAANJ (990 Shoppes Blvd), Golden Tiger Karate School (570 Georges Rd) and Master Nick's Karate (1463 Finnegan Ln).
issues.fix: Add the three confirmed schools from the coverage list below; verify Master Nick's separately.

issues.claim: Coverage of retail and repair categories
issues.problem: Missing independent businesses found in my own searches: North Brunswick Cobbler Shop (918 Livingston Ave, shoe/leather repair), Fashion Unlimited (1463 Finnegans Ln #7, South Asian clothing) and Carpet & Futon Gallery (770 Georges Rd, flooring). Dry cleaners also returned 5+ town businesses (e.g. Hallelujah Dry Cleaning 1890 US-130, Finnegan Cleaners 1525 Finnegan Ln, Lorenzo Tailoring 699 Georges Rd) that are absent if laundry/tailoring counts as in scope.
issues.fix: Add the three confirmed retail/repair businesses; decide explicitly whether dry cleaning/tailoring is in group D and, if so, add those listings.

issues.claim: Entries with no website though the business publishes one
issues.problem: Three entries leave website blank even though the business has its own site: DeVries (njpatiofurniture.com), North Brunswick Gold Exchange (northbrunswickgoldexchange.com), Balaji Flowers (balajiflowersusa.com). Balaji also operates Edison and Herndon VA locations, so it is a small multi-site business.
issues.fix: Fill in the websites and note Balaji's multi-location footprint for triage.

issues.claim: Fields marked Unknown that are published by the business
issues.problem: Data completeness defects: Pay Less Furniture phone is published on its own About page (732-745-9500) but recorded as Unknown; DeVries phone is 732-297-1244 on its own contact page; Rosie Rose's street address appears only on its /find-us page, which was not cited; Eagle's Landing Events' address (74 Davidson's Mill Rd) was left Unknown.
issues.fix: Fill these from the businesses' own pages and cite them.

issues.claim: Directory-only entries with no independent confirmation (DClase Joyeria, Gold Exchange, Anything ZYX1, Cha Cha Gifts, Duchess Florals, A C Compacting LLC, Smart Phone Doctor, Nam-It Engraving & Signs and others)

Main St, Milltown with a different phone (732-247-1004), so the 1520 Jersey Ave North Brunswick record is unverified.
